_: Denominational electives held back from the site, by code (A-C1 … D-C5). A held course keeps its units, but has no textbook, reading room or reading test on the site. tools/build-elective-textbook.mjs and tools/build-elective-readings.mjs refuse a held code; tools/import-readings.mjs skips its row; tools/import-electives.mjs gives its units no course-readings box; tools/gen-worker-catalog.mjs fails if a held course has a textbook, a reading test, a room or a READING_ROOM entry. Remove a code here only when its hold is lifted (docs/reading-rooms.md).
